There’s so much to love about this app, but ultimately, the downloads don’t work and never have. I’ve recommended this app to many people before, and always loved it. I’ve even paid the premium subscription before in the past. 

However the recent updates have been a dealbreaker for me. The episode limits (which used to just be how many NEW episodes it would download) now apply to ALL episodes. This means that it literally won’t let you download more episodes unless you turn off the limits.

For podcasts with daily episodes, this is an absolute nightmare. I had a 1-3 episode limit for these, and I could just manually pick the ones I wanted instead of filling up my storage. However that’s not possible now, and even just a few days of this update has added over 1gb to my storage. 

There have also been some pretty annoying changes with previous updates too. For instance, if a specific episode has custom episode art, the title is pushed over to the right. Titles without custom art are justified all the way to the left. This means you can’t easily scroll a list, because the titles are now essentially in two different columns. 

I totally get that it’s just one person making this, so I know that can occasionally come with hiccups, but I’m just so confused how decisions are being made for such a popular app. It feels like the developer is just making choices based on HIS own podcasts, not what others use it for. 

I’m pretty sure something from every new update recently has had to be rolled back or fixed, which doesn’t reflect very well on however decisions are being made. 

I’ve worked in tech for years, and UX/UI testing is really crucial, even for small teams of developers. There are some pretty avoidable mistakes that keep happening that it seems like would have been caught from user testing. 

The benefits of using the app now are outweighed by the negative, which is really disappointing. I hope this episode limit change gets rolled back because otherwise I literally won’t have the phone storage to keep listening to podcasts on this app, which feels crazy to me.

Marco, if you’re going to lean on Claude to code your app, you have enough time to make thoughtful decisions on feature roll-out. Instead, you released a strict episode limit that breaks longstanding functionality and user behavior. Your rollout was user-hostile and destructive of users’ playlists, podcast settings, and good will. You would have absolutely roasted Tim Cook for a decision like this. I’ve been an Overcast user since launch because I believed it’s best-in-class, but the negligence and hubris of this rollout resonates with the increasing out-of-touch perspective you bring to ATP.
What used to be a great app has been junked up with premium upsells and AI features. Let me turn this stuff off.

The new version’s episode limit behavior is a no-win for anyone who used it as-intended previously — on first launch of the new version I’m forced to either delete all 100+ episodes I manually downloaded, or unilaterally wipe out all the soft limits I deliberately set per show: both are forms of data loss and there’s no option to simply retain the app’s previous behavior. I painstakingly set the per show limits so automatic downloads wouldn’t accumulate on their own but I could still manually add episodes beyond the automatic limit when I wanted; this was how this core feature was designed and telegraphed so it’s how I trusted it to work; I saw nothing wrong with that and it should have at least been retained as an option. Instead I have to choose which of my work Overcast will delete before I can use the app again. Bad experience and a betrayal of user expectations for sure.
